faqItems.a: Hilm (also HILM or حلم) is an AI Personal Operating System and Workspace OS. It combines projects, tasks, Mission Control, documentation, daily logs, and an AI Chief of Staff that can propose and apply real changes in your workspace.

Hilm helps you run work in one system: manage projects and tasks, schedule days in Mission Control, capture daily logs, write docs, and use AI agents for multi-step automation with confirm-then-apply actions.

faqItems.q: Is Hilm an AI project management tool?
faqItems.a: Yes. Hilm is an AI-native personal and workspace operating system for project and task management — not a standalone chatbot. The AI is grounded in your Hilm data and can create, update, and organize work inside the product.
Hilm is a Progressive Web App at hillm.netlify.app. Use it in the browser or install it on desktop and mobile. It supports English and Arabic.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Hilm is designed so your operating system stays yours.
privacy.p1: Account data, projects, and AI conversation history are stored in your Supabase project under row-level security. AI requests use Hilm’s OpenRouter key on the server — never shipped in the client bundle.
privacy.p2: Offline caches live on your device via IndexedDB and the service worker. You can request export of your data from Settings as that surface ships.
